items.title: vi) Kinetic energy based on KMT

source_refs.note: vi) Kinetic energy based on KMT: a main subheading of 5.11 General properties of solids, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 109-109.

blocks.text: Kinetic energy is due to the motion of constituent particles of a solid. Solid particles have only vibratory motion and they do not have translational or rotational motion. Therefore, the only kinetic energy that solids possess is vibrational kinetic energy.
